subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 1/4] exportfs/mountd/exportd: track the svc_export policy highest attribute

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch updates the exportfs and mountd modules to track the highest attribute in the kernel's svc_export netlink policy, which is used to determine what attributes should be sent to older kernels that may reject them. The patch adds a new field 'max_attr' to the nfsd_export_policy structure and populates it with the maximum attribute value from the policy. This change is necessary to avoid sending attributes that an older kernel would reject, causing the whole entry to be rejected. The patch also updates the exportfs module's logging to include the maximum attribute value.
